name: Senpai
source:
A dashing but unsociable 12th-grader who does part-time work in a modelling agency thrice a week. He's fairly popular in school, especially among female upperclassmen, but even they keep their distance.

Will respond when approached, but conversations with him somehow always end up on the short side.
